READ COMMITTED uses a fresh statement snapshot; do not generalize to every Repeatable Read implementation.

Equality on the leading key and a range on the next key define a contiguous interval; a usable index is not a promised planner choice. PostgreSQL 18 also supports skip scans, so do not claim every missing leading predicate makes an index unusable.
Covering all requested columns does not eliminate MVCC visibility checks; heap fetches depend on the visibility map.
Trace the circular wait; do not predict which transaction is selected as the victim.
Trace the inserted row with unique immutable ordering. Keyset pagination avoids this positional shift but does not create a cross-request snapshot.
Sequence advancement is not rolled back with row changes; a primary key need not be gapless.
TCP preserves an ordered byte stream, not send boundaries; a parser must retain incomplete headers and bodies.
EOF after FIN concerns the receive direction. A server may still send a response on its open send direction.
304 supports reuse of a matching stored representation and applicable metadata; it is not an empty replacement body.
no-cache requires validation for reuse; no-store prohibits storage. Neither header should be described as equivalent to the other.
A trusted certificate chain does not establish that its identity matches the requested host; do not recommend disabling identity verification.
dup descriptors reference one open file description and share its offset; two independent opens differ.
Removing the last link does not free the file while an open reference remains; filesystem/accounting delays are outside the seed.
Unread bytes need not produce a new edge; use nonblocking draining to EAGAIN, without assuming readiness equals a complete message.

Pipelining reduces network waits and is not an isolation boundary; permit interleaving without asserting it occurs on every run.
Compare the unique ownership token atomically before release. Safe release alone does not stop a stale owner from modifying an external resource.
allkeys-lru can select keys without TTL and is approximate; do not guarantee that K is the exact victim.
Bind values separately from SQL syntax; parameters cannot stand for arbitrary identifiers and do not replace authorization.
A simple cross-site form can send a credentialed request under the explicit cookie assumptions; blocking response reads does not prevent the state change.
Ordinary comparisons with NULL produce unknown; a WHERE clause keeps only true rows.
Private address spaces diverge on writes; copy-on-write is an implementation optimization, not shared-memory synchronization.
An async throw rejects the returned Promise, including before its first await; an outer synchronous catch does not catch that rejection.
